newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut's leading stocks mixed, Solidere A slows.
newsitem.headline: Beirut's leading stocks mixed, Solidere A slows.

text.p: Leading stocks were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday and brokers said renewed profit-taking in Solidere A shares slowed its upward move.
"Solidere had a higher supply today. Some people wanted to sell at good prices at a time of profit taking," said a broker who requested anonymity.
Total turnover in Solidere shares fell 18.9 percent to 299,658 shares from 356,502. Total supply of Solidere shares in the first fixing was 940,814 against demand of 337,607.
Solidere A shares fell to $13.00 from $13.375 while B shares rose to $13.5 from that level.
Bank shares were mixed. Banque Libanais pour le Commerce rose to $21.875 from $21.375. Bank of Beirut rose slightly to $4.9375 from $4.875 while Banque Audi fell to $28.5 from $28.75.
On Wednesday, Banque Audi said it posted mid-year profits of $11.05 million -- a rise of 18.7 percent over the same period of 1996.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.91 percent to 189.39. The BLOM general index fell 1.07 percent to 1124.51 and the LISPI general index increased 0.07 percent to 96.25.
BSE turnover fell to 388,834 shares from 415,702 for a value of $5,033,388 against $5,383,159.
There was no trade in the other three industrial firms -- Ciments Blanc, Eternit and Uniceramic
